data.one_liner: Shows native iOS and macOS equivalents of CupertinoAlertDialog and CupertinoActionSheet.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin that enables developers to display native iOS alerts and action sheets, providing authentic platform look and feel. It supports various button types like default, destructive, and cancel, with customization options matching native iOS guidelines.
use_when: You want authentic native iOS and macOS dialogs instead of Flutter's Cupertino equivalents
You need standard alert dialogs or action sheets with native styling and button states
avoid_when: Your app requires a uniform Material or custom cross-platform design across all systems
You are targeting Android or web platforms primarily
strengths: Provides real native iOS dialog and action sheet experiences
Supports customized button styles such as destructive, cancel, and disabled
weaknesses: Limited to iOS and macOS platforms
Action sheets on iPadOS have version limitations documented in the changelog
